question: The figure-to-data step as its own part after the conversion, with three reading methods behind one folder contract: a local open model (ollama), one call to a cloud model's API (cloud), one agent session per figure (agent). How good is each on the same prepared figures, and what does it cost? The cloud method was run with two models through OpenRouter.
figures: the 15 of ../testset.json (10 data charts, 560 truth values in 33 panels; 5 without data)
bundles: samples/aca-papers_out, converted with extrct_docling-v2.131.0-r4, default configuration (unchanged from round 1)

step.code: docling/engines/figure_data: prepare.py, methods/, reading.py, report.py, step.py, publish.py
step.prepare: amir-figdata prepare --testset ../testset.json --out <work>/prepared (once, no model; 220 dpi PDF render or the embedded bitmap, capped at 3,200 px; PDF text merged with RapidOCR; charts found by tick labels, then gutters)
step.read: one copy of the prepared folders per method; amir-figdata read <work>/<label> --method <method> (scripts/run_round3.sh)

ollama-gemma4-26b-qat.engine: the round-2 measured engine, unchanged (round-2/LOG.md); temperature 0, think false, 120 s per call, 600 s per figure

cloud-sonnet-5-5.backend: openai-compatible: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, one request per figure, key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env
cloud-sonnet-5-5.input: the figure (long side at most 2,000 px), one crop per chart when several were found, figure.txt
cloud-sonnet-5-5.reply_schema: in the system prompt only: Anthropic refused it as response_format (limit of 16 nullable fields, the reading has 22) and the method asked again without the field

cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.backend: openai-compatible: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, one request per figure, key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env
cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.input: the figure (long side at most 2,000 px), one crop per chart when several were found, figure.txt
cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.reply_schema: enforced as response_format, every field required
cloud-gemini-3-8-flash.note: second run. The first, with the limit at 32,000, was cut on the dense stacked bars and is in superseded/cloud-gemini-3-8-flash-v1. In this run the line chart B2 came back as an empty reply after 130 s and was read again on its own after the retry for empty replies was added; seconds and cost count that second reading (LOG.md section 10)

agent-sonnet-5-5.backend: claude-cli: Claude Code 2.1.326 headless, one session per figure, effort high
agent-sonnet-5-5.input: the figure and figure.txt; everything else through look
agent-sonnet-5-5.note: second run; the first, with check feedback that did not say how to fix a naming problem, is in superseded/agent-sonnet-5-5-v1 (LOG.md section 4)

isolation.ollama: local; the model sees one chart crop and its words per call
isolation.cloud: one HTTP request per figure; the model gets the system prompt and one message and has no tool and no file access
isolation.agent: a session whose only tools are the three of one MCP server bound to one figure folder; no file, shell or web tool. Checked per session from its event stream: runs/<label>/AUDIT.md
isolation.lock: the truth and judge folders were unreadable (chmod 000) during the first wave, the Sonnet cloud run and the first Gemini run (scripts/run_round3.sh); the agent reruns and the second Gemini run ran without the lock, their models having no file tool

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark, unified memory); the local model alone on the GPU
hardware.ollama: 0.32.14 (image budget for Gemma 4 capped at about 270 tokens; round-2/LOG.md F9)

cost: USD. agent: as the Claude Code CLI reports per session (total_cost_usd, list prices). cloud: usage.cost as OpenRouter returns it with each reply. Not reported for local runs

judge.judge_agent: one general-purpose sub-agent per run, fresh context, tools on, read-only on the repository
judge.prompt: judge/PROMPT.md (the round-2 prompt with round-3 paths)
judge.isolation: a judge reads one run's outputs only, no other judge's file, nothing of rounds 1 and 2, not this round's README or LOG

extra/agent-gemma4-26b-qat.backend: the same session through Ollama's Anthropic-compatible endpoint; 300 s per figure
extra/agent-gemma4-26b-qat.note: an extra, in extra/: stopped by hand after 7 of 15 figures and 887 s; it shows that the agent runs on a local model, it is not one of the three methods compared and was not judged

superseded/cloud-gemini-3-8-flash-v1.note: first Gemini run, output limit 32,000: 299 values, 939 s, 0.62 USD; scored automatically, not judged

superseded/agent-sonnet-5-5-v1.note: first agent run, before the check feedback said how to fix a naming problem
